verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Teams supports creating and configuring channels (and automating team/channel creation via Graph), implying admins can organize conversations into channels, but the evidence never explicitly describes public vs. private channel types or granular membership control settings. Community feedback also flags channel/threading UX confusion, suggesting the experience isn't seamless. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of public/private channel distinction, membership permission controls, and hands-on validation that admins can manage channel membership reliably.
